edits.name: Restore native scenario select arrow in high contrast
edits.before: [data-dissection-root][data-high-contrast="true"] .diss-scenario-console, [data-dissection-root][data-high-contrast="true"] .diss-scenario-console :is(h4, h5, p, label, select, button, .diss-scenario-console__state, .diss-scenario-console__timer, .diss-scenario-console__restart-review) { border-color: #111827; background: #fff; color: #000; }
edits.after:
[data-dissection-root][data-high-contrast="true"] .diss-scenario-console, [data-dissection-root][data-high-contrast="true"] .diss-scenario-console :is(h4, h5, p, label, select, button, .diss-scenario-console__state, .diss-scenario-console__timer, .diss-scenario-console__restart-review) { border-color: #111827; background: #fff; color: #000; }
[data-dissection-root][data-high-contrast="true"] .diss-scenario-console select { appearance: auto; }

edits.name: Restore native scenario select arrow in forced colors
edits.before:
[data-dissection-root] .diss-scenario-console__progress > span { background: Highlight !important; }
  [data-dissection-root] .diss-scenario-console :is(button, select):focus-visible { outline-color: Highlight !important; }
